basic_details.job_title: TISS Admin cum Finance Officer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online

qualification.details: Proficiency in English and Hindi (spoken and written). Working knowledge of MS Office (particularly Excel), data entry, MIS and ERP systems. Understanding of GST, TDS and invoicing processes is desirable. Prior experience in an academic institution, CSR project or NGO setting is desirable. Attention to detail, sound record-keeping practices and the ability to meet deadlines. Ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders and handle several projects at once.

salary_details.details: The remuneration is a consolidated amount per month as specified in the official notification.

selection_process: The selection process comprises the shortlisting of applications followed by Personal Interaction (Offline/ Online).
how_to_apply: Prepare your CV with the required details of your qualifications and experience.
Compose a new email addressed to [email protected].
Set the subject line of the email strictly to “Application for Admin cum Finance Officer”.
Attach your CV to the email.
Send the email on or before 23 October 2026 up to 5:00 PM.
important_instructions: The engagement is short-term for a period of 6 months initially, extendable based on performance and requirements. Merely possessing the prescribed minimum qualifications and experience does not entitle a person to be called for Personal Interaction. Canvassing in any form is strictly prohibited and will lead to disqualification. Suppression of factual information, supply of fake documents, or providing false information will lead to immediate disqualification or termination. The Institute reserves the right to not fill up the vacancy advertised or to invite persons for Personal Interaction who may not have applied. No queries or correspondence regarding the issue of call letters will be entertained.

faq.question: Q1. What is the recruitment for?
faq.answer: It is for the post of Admin cum Finance Officer at the Centre for Excellence in CSR (CECSR), Tata Institute of Social Sciences (TISS), Mumbai on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for the Admin cum Finance Officer post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date for receiving applications is 23 October 2026 till 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a B.Com degree or diploma in Finance/Accounts Management, with a minimum of six months of administrative or accounts work experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered?
faq.answer: The consolidated salary ranges from INR 38,000/- to 40,000/- per month.
